BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4637.name: Grandwalker Dan
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4637.effect:
[Grandwalker Nexus]
This Nexus can only be affected by effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses. Cores can only be placed on this Nexus via Core Charge or effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses, and cannot be moved from this Nexus except via effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses.

[Core Charge: (Astral Deity/Galaxian & Cost 3 or more)]
◆When you Summon/Advent a target Spirit, you can put one core from the void onto this Nexus.
◆When this Nexus is deployed, if you do not control a Grandwalker Nexus with the same card name, you can send three cards from your decktop to the Trash. For each target card among them, put one core from the void onto this Nexus.

[LV1][LV2]
Add every "Galaxian" family card sent to Trash by this Nexus's [Core Charge] to your Hand.

[Grand Skill: 4] [LV1][LV2] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
(Once per turn, send four cores from this Nexus to the Void) Destroy an opposing 10000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate. Also, during this turn, the opponent can't end the Attack Step via effects.

[Grand Field] [LV2]
While there are six or less cards in your Hand, your Hand is unaffected by opposing effects.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13837.effect:
When this card was either revealed from deck by the effect of your exactly-named "Godseeker HieroglyphCavalry Spotter-Sheneut" or sent to the Trash by the effect of your exactly-named "Grandwalker Thoth," you can add it to your Hand. When you've done so, put one core from the Void to any Grandwalker Nexus you control.

[Flash]
During this turn, your Life can't be reduced to one or less by opposing effects and the attacks of opposing Cost 4 or more Spirits/Ultimates. Also, by sending two cores from any exactly-named "Grandwalker Thoth" you control to the Void, return an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the deckbottom.
